description.name: Zenith Mode: Dr. Mog (Prismatic)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, elemental abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Dr. Mog (Prismatic) after using two elemental abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Dr. Mog's Secret+
description.text: Four single attacks (3.60/3.75 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Dr. Mog's Water Vortex+
description.text: Six single attacks (?/? each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Conditional Attach Element 2 with Stacking From Party
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] if current number of combined Attach Element statuses on party members are a majority Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison. In the case of ties the prior listed order is used to determine status granted

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action

description.name: Wisdom of Creation Mode
description.text: If the character hasn't any Infusion grants [Conditional Attach Element] after using an ability based on the ability's element
